50008-the-kacha-ris.title: The Kacha Ris
50008-the-kacha-ris.creator: Unknown
50008-the-kacha-ris.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The people generally known to us as "Kacháris" differ in some material ways from their Hindu and Musulmán neighbours alike in things material and moral. They are certainly not a tall or handsome race, and in general appearance bear some resemblance to the Nepáli, being as a rule shorter and stouter than the people of North-west India, though well fitted to bear up against physical fatigue and hardship.

arxiv-2102-01762.title: Profinite genus of fundamental groups of compact flat manifolds with the cyclic holonomy group of square-free order
arxiv-2102-01762.creator: Genildo de Jesus Nery
arxiv-2102-01762.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Genildo de Jesus Nery. In this article we study the extent to which an n n -dimensional compact flat manifold with the cyclic holonomy group of square-free order may be distinguished by the finite quotients of its fundamental group. In particular, we display a formula for the cardinality of profinite genus of the fundamental group of an n n -dimensional compact flat manifold with the cyclic holonomy group of square-free order. Keywords: Profinite genus; Bieberbach group; compact flat manifold.

arxiv-2107-02212.title: Featurized Density Ratio Estimation
arxiv-2107-02212.creator: Kristy Choi, Madeline Liao ∗, Stefano Ermon
arxiv-2107-02212.description: Abstract Density ratio estimation serves as an important technique in the unsupervised machine learning toolbox. However, such ratios are difficult to estimate for complex, high-dimensional data, particularly when the densities of interest are sufficiently different. In our work, we propose to leverage an invertible generative model to map the two distributions into a common feature space prior to estimation.

arxiv-2201-04251.title: A criterion for cofiniteness of modules
arxiv-2201-04251.creator: Mohammad Khazaei and Reza Sazeedeh
arxiv-2201-04251.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Khazaei and Reza Sazeedeh. Let A A be a commutative noetherian ring, 𝔞 \mathfrak{a} be an ideal of A A , m , n m,n be non-negative integers and let M M be an A A -module such that Ext A i ⁡ ( A / 𝔞 , M ) \Ext^{i}_{A}(A/\mathfrak{a},M) is finitely generated for all i ≤ m + n i\leq m+n .

arxiv-2302-14300.title: On the consistency of Λ \Lambda CDM with CMB measurements in light of the latest Planck, ACT and SPT data
arxiv-2302-14300.creator: and Wuhyun Sohn
arxiv-2302-14300.description: Abstract Using Gaussian Processes we perform a thorough, non-parametric consistency test of the Λ \Lambda CDM model when confronted with state-of-the-art TT, TE, and EE measurements of the anisotropies in the Cosmic Microwave Background by the Planck , ACT, and SPT collaborations.

arxiv-2306-12214.title: More PAC-Bayes bounds: From bounded losses, to losses with general tail behaviors, to anytime validity
arxiv-2306-12214.creator: Borja Rodríguez-Gálvez borjarg@kth.se, Ragnar Thobabenragnart@kth.se, Mikael Skoglundskoglund@kth.se
arxiv-2306-12214.description: Abstract In this paper, we present new high-probability PAC-Bayes bounds for different types of losses. Firstly, for losses with a bounded range, we recover a strengthened version of Catoni’s bound that holds uniformly for all parameter values. This leads to new fast-rate and mixed-rate bounds that are interpretable and tighter than previous bounds in the literature.

arxiv-2308-06811.title: BiHeartS: Bilateral Heart Rate from multiple devices and body positions for Sleep measurement Dataset
arxiv-2308-06811.creator: Nouran Abdalazim, Leonardo Alchieri, Lidia Alecci, Silvia Santini
arxiv-2308-06811.description: Abstract Sleep is the primary mean of recovery from accumulated fatigue and thus plays a crucial role in fostering people’s mental and physical well-being. Sleep quality monitoring systems are often implemented using wearables that leverage their sensing capabilities to provide sleep behaviour insights and recommendations to users.

arxiv-2407-17596.title: Quality Assured: Rethinking Annotation Strategies in Imaging AI
arxiv-2407-17596.creator: Tim Rädsch✉, Annika Reinke, Vivienn Weru, Minu D. Tizabi, Nicholas Heller, Fabian Isensee, Annette Kopp-Schneider*, Lena Maier-Hein*✉
arxiv-2407-17596.description: Abstract This paper does not describe a novel method. Instead, it studies an essential foundation for reliable benchmarking and ultimately real-world application of AI-based image analysis: generating high-quality reference annotations. Previous research has focused on crowdsourcing as a means of outsourcing annotations.

arxiv-2501-07208.title: A Secure Remote Password Protocol From The Learning With Errors Problem
arxiv-2501-07208.creator: 1 st Huapeng Li, 2 nd Baocheng Wang
arxiv-2501-07208.description: Abstract Secure Remote Password ( SRP ) protocol is an important password-authenticated key exchange ( PAKE ) protocol based on the discrete logarithm problem ( DLP ). The protocol is specifically designed to work for parties to obtain a session key and it is widely used in various scenarios due to its attractive security features.

arxiv-2510-13445.title: Robust Minimax Boosting with Performance Guarantees
arxiv-2510-13445.creator: Santiago Mazuelas, Verónica Álvarez
arxiv-2510-13445.description: Abstract Boosting methods often achieve excellent classification accuracy, but can experience notable performance degradation in the presence of label noise. Existing robust methods for boosting provide theoretical robustness guarantees for certain types of label noise, and can exhibit only moderate performance degradation.

arxiv-2606-13461.title: Reinforcement Learning for Neural Model Editing
arxiv-2606-13461.creator: Shaivi Malik

pmc-10577781.title: Singlet and Triplet Pathways Determine the Thermal Z/E Isomerization of an Arylazopyrazole-Based Photoswitch
pmc-10577781.creator: Nadja
pmc-10577781.description: Understanding the thermal isomerization mechanism of azobenzene derivatives is essential to designing photoswitches with tunable half-lives. Herein, we employ quantum chemical calculations, nonadiabatic transition state theory, and photosensitized experiments to unravel the thermal Z/E isomerization of a heteroaromatic azoswitch, the phenylazo-1,3,5-trimethylpyrazole. In contrast to the parent azobenzene, we predict two pathways to be operative at room temperature.

pmc-11493958.title: The moderation effect of GSTM1/GSTT1 gene polymorphisms on the association of sperm mitochondrial DNA copy number and sperm mobility
pmc-11493958.creator: Tingting Zhang, Shengnan Zhang, Chen Zhang, Huan Liu, Mingming Liu, Guang-hui Zhang, Guangcai Duan, Shuaiyin Chen, Jingchao Ren
pmc-11493958.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Oxidative stress (OS) is believed to be a significant factor in the decline of semen quality, with mitochondrial DNA copy number (mtDNAcn) serving as a sensitive biomarker for both semen quality and mitochondrial dysfunction resulting from oxidative stress. While glutathione S-transferases (GSTs) are commonly known as ‘antioxidant’ enzymes, there is ongoing debate regarding the relationship between GST genotypes and semen quality.

pmc-11674780.title: The Value of Bone Marrow Assessment by FDG PET/CT, Biopsy and Aspirate in the Upfront Evaluation of Mantle Cell Lymphoma: A Nationwide Cohort Study
pmc-11674780.creator: Isabel Ródenas Quiñonero, Javier Marco-Ayala, Tzu-Hua Chen-Liang, Fátima de la Cruz-Vicente, Tycho Baumann, José-Tomás Navarro, Alejandro Martín García-Sancho, Taida Martin-Santos, Javier López-Jiménez, Rafael Andreu, Esther Parra-Virto, Andrea Usas, David Alonso, Marta Fernández-González, Pablo Pal
pmc-11674780.description: Simple SummaryThis research explores the role of different methods for assessing bone marrow infiltration (BMI) in mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) during initial diagnosis. Traditional bone marrow biopsy (BMB) is a standard procedure, but newer imaging techniques like PET/CT scans may offer additional or alternative insights.

pmc-12610507.title: Enhancing Driver Monitoring Systems Based on Novel Multi-Task Fusion Algorithm
pmc-12610507.creator: Romas Vijeikis, Ibidapo Dare Dada, Adebayo A. Abayomi-Alli, Vidas Raudonis
pmc-12610507.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights What are the main findings? A multi-perceptive and multi-task driver monitoring model is developed.A multi-task fusion algorithm for determining if the driver is attentive enough to drive safely is developed. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-12630466.title: Rooting for function: community‐level fine‐root traits relate to many ecosystem functions
pmc-12630466.creator: Kathryn E. Barry, Justus Hennecke, Alexandra Weigelt, Joana Bergmann, Helge Bruelheide, Grégoire T. Freschet, Colleen M. Iversen, Thomas W. Kuyper, Daniel C. Laughlin, M. Luke McCormack, Catherine Roumet, Fons van der Plas, Jasper van Ruijven, Rachel Wijsmuller, Harald Auge, Nico Eisenhauer, Josephi
pmc-12630466.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Summary Humans are driving biodiversity change, which also alters community functional traits. However, how changes in the functional traits of the community alter ecosystem functions—especially belowground—remains an important gap in our understanding of the consequences of biodiversity change.We test hypotheses for how the root traits of the root economics space (composed of the collaboration and conservation gradients) are associated with proxies for ecosystem functioning across grassland and forest ecosystems in both observational and experimental datasets from 810 plant communities.

pmc-12718269.title: SEOH, a novel marine-derived spirostenoid: potent broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity against multidrug-resistant aquaculture pathogens
pmc-12718269.creator: Rewan Abdelaziz, Gamal EL-Didamony, Azza S. El-Demerdash, Rania A. ElDaly
pmc-12718269.description: The escalating challenge of antibiotic resistance in aquaculture critically threatens global fish health and food security, underscoring an urgent need for novel antimicrobial strategies. This study explored the bioactive potential of metabolites from the marine actinomycete Streptomyces zaomyceticus, isolated from a deep-sea sediment sample off Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt.

pmc-12860182.title: Adaptive control ankle robotics training durably improves gait biomechanics in chronic hemiparetic stroke and footdrop
pmc-12860182.creator: Anindo Roy, Bradley Hennessie, Charlene Hafer-Macko, Larry W Forrester, Kelly Westlake, Richard F Macko
pmc-12860182.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundRobotics has emerged as a promising avenue for gait rehabilitation after stroke. We developed a wearable ankle exoskeleton (AMBLE) for dorsiflexion assist-as-needed training with adaptive control timing to individualize assistance across gait cycle sub-events.

pmc-13245751.title: Plasma proteomics improves risk prediction in heart failure and reveals unique biology in chronic chagas cardiomyopathy
pmc-13245751.creator: José S. L. Patané, Fernando R. Giugni, Rogério S. Rosa, Fabiana G. Marcondes-Braga, Alfredo J. Mansur, Alexandre C. Pereira, Jose E. Krieger, Guilherme L Werneck, Karina Gómez, Guilherme L Werneck, Karina Gómez, Guilherme L Werneck, Karina Gómez, Guilherme L Werneck, Karina Gómez
pmc-13245751.description: BackgroundChronic Chagas cardiomyopathy (CCC) remains a major cause of heart failure (HF)–related mortality in Latin America and is increasingly recognized as a global health concern. Prognostic models developed in non-Chagas populations often perform poorly in CCC, highlighting the need for etiology-specific risk stratification.Methodology/principal findingsWe applied high-throughput plasma proteomics to evaluate 2-year mortality risk in CCC compared with other HF etiologies.

pmc-13392907.title: Beyond the Colon: Acute Hemolysis Associated With Etrasimod Therapy
pmc-13392907.creator: Sohaib Ahmed, Saud Khan, Eric Vargas Carranza, Syed Usman Mumtaz, Michael Delzoppo

pmc-13623971.title: Listeria promotes systemic infection by targeting the host deubiquitinase CYLD
pmc-13623971.creator: Dustin A Ammendolia, Cara J Ellison, Yuelin Zheng, Etienne Coyaud, Estelle M N Laurent, Bing-Ru Yan, Bri Manning, Anna K Waldmann, Joel M J Tan, Scott Frendo-Cumbo, Carina Lyons, Ji-Young Youn, Brian Raught, Keith Ireton, Darren E Higgins, Paul R Elliott, John H Brumell
pmc-13623971.description: Listeria monocytogenes (Lm) is an intracellular pathogen that can cause life-threatening systemic infections. Internalin C (InlC) is a secreted factor required for full Lm virulence in systemic models of infection by mechanisms that remain unclear. Here, we show that InlC binds to CYLD, a host deubiquitinase and regulator of innate immunity.

pmc-13634001.title: Technique-specific reduction of sciatic nerve stiffness through neurodynamic stretches at submaximal and maximal intensity in asymptomatic individuals
pmc-13634001.creator: Marion Hitier, Denis César Leite Vieira, Carole Cometti, Joao Luiz Quagliotti Durigan, Nicolas Babault
pmc-13634001.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeTo compare the immediate effects of two neurodynamic mobilization techniques (flossing vs. tensioning) on the sciatic nerve and hamstring muscle tissues, using different stretching intensities.MethodsTwenty physically active volunteers performed a randomized, study comprising seven conditions (six stretching + control). Interventions included static stretching (SS), neurodynamic tensioning (TENS), and neurodynamic flossing (FLOS), applied at 100% (pain threshold) or 90% maximal range of motion, using 5 × 60-s sets.
